chart.title: Cumulative NPV and monthly liquid production
errorHint: Rebuild the data: docker compose run --rm webdata.
legend.cursorDot: The round handle on the scale is the current step.
legend.dash: A dash means the well is not commissioned: the value does not exist, it is not a zero.
legend.marks: Ticks under the time scale are field events: green — commissioned, orange — converted to injection, red — shut in.
legend.selected: The highlighted row is the selected well, the same one highlighted in every other view.
legend.setpoint: Setpoint is what the rules assigned; actual is what the well delivered.
legend.sort: Click a column header to sort the table.
legend.step: The table shows the fund at the selected step — the step is set by the time scale below.
legend.title: Encoding
scaleEmpty: Control steps are not loaded yet
table.caption: Wells at the selected step: setpoints, actuals and mode
